script_text: Stop, Taurus: Uranus is battering down the fortress you call financial security! In your 2nd House, Uranus forms an opposition to your 8th House of shared money, debt, intimacy, and karmic ties. Because Taurus is an Earth sign ruled by Venus, this pressure disturbs your stability and exposes dependencies you would rather ignore. In love, one honest conversation beats flirtation; single Taureans attract someone independent yet emotionally guarded, while partners should watch for jealousy triggered by money, secrecy, or unequal priorities. Career-wise, this 2nd-to-8th House opposition calls for reviewing joint accounts, contracts, taxes, and income dependencies before a surprise tax demand, delayed payment, or partnership contract lands today. Avoid an impulsive purchase meant to calm nerves; the unexpected gift is release from a draining obligation. Follow for tomorrow’s reading, and subscribe so you don’t miss what this Uranus opposition unlocks.
